digest.component_or_area: store migration / ensure units / projects mapping
propositions: Existing stores lack .bridge_state/projects.json and bridge_project fields on tickets, causing them to read every ticket as absent-project with no recorded legacy default
Two idempotent ensure units must seed the projects mapping and conditionally stamp the multi-project-bridge capability without writing any ticket events
The seed unit writes legacy_default once; resolve_project treats every absent-field ticket as belonging to it, converging the whole store with a single small write
The stamp unit adds multi-project-bridge to required_capabilities only when the mapping already holds more than one project (level-triggered convergence backstop)
A one-project mapping must leave required_capabilities empty so the store stays usable by older binaries
The two units are registered in REGISTRY_IDS/_registry, tested for convergence and zero ticket-event writes, and must pass idempotence and compat-gate safety checks
